name: DuckDuckGo AI Chat
good_for: Great for asking questions in private - it does not track you, and you can switch between models like GPT, Claude, and Llama.
watch_out: The more advanced AI models need a paid DuckDuckGo subscription, which starts at $9.99 a month.

good_for: Chatting with many open-source AI models in one app, using a Hugging Face account.
name: HuggingChat
watch_out: You need a Hugging Face account, and Hugging Face says free accounts get no monthly credits for the models behind it, so count on the $9-a-month PRO plan or buying credits.

good_for: It's a free desktop app that runs AI models right on your computer, so what you type stays private unless you choose its optional paid cloud models.
name: LM Studio
watch_out: You need a fairly strong computer: 16GB of memory is recommended, and 8GB works only with smaller models.

name: Lovable
good_for: Great for non-programmers: describe the app or website you want in plain words and it builds a working version for you.
watch_out: The free plan gives you 5 build credits a day (up to 30 a month), and bigger tasks cost more credits; the Pro plan costs $25 a month, or $21 a month if you pay for a year.

name: NotebookLM
good_for: Great for studying: upload your documents and ask it questions, or turn them into a podcast-style audio chat between two AI hosts.
watch_out: It only answers from the documents you upload, so weak sources mean weak answers.

name: Otter.ai
good_for: Joins your meetings and writes down what everyone says, so you get notes and summaries without typing a word.
watch_out: The free plan gives you 300 transcription minutes a month and only 3 file imports in total; the Pro plan costs $16.99 a month, or $8.33 a month if you pay for a year.

name: Perplexity Comet
good_for: A web browser with an AI assistant built in that can summarize pages, compare products, and do small tasks for you.
watch_out: The free version of Comet does not include the browser agent that does tasks for you; that needs a paid Perplexity plan.

name: Photoshop (generative fill)
good_for: Inside Photoshop, add or remove anything in a photo with a text prompt - the AI fills in the rest to match.
watch_out: You need a paid plan: Photoshop costs $22.99 a month (annual plan, billed monthly) and includes 25 generative credits a month, while unlimited Generative Fill comes with Creative Cloud Pro at $69.99 a month.

good_for: Type a description and it creates images for you, with lots of ready-made style templates to start from.
name: Playground AI
watch_out: The free plan is limited to 5 images every 3 hours and 6 credits a month, and runs slower at busy times, and the premium models use monthly credits.

name: Poe
good_for: Great for trying many different AI models in one app - GPT, Claude, Llama, and more - and comparing their answers side by side.
watch_out: The free plan limits how much you can chat each day; the paid plan costs $4.99 a month.

name: Remove.bg
price_from: Free to try until 1 December 2026 (the pricing page no longer sells paid plans)
good_for: Removes the background from any photo in seconds with one click - great for product shots and profile pictures; the website closes on 1 December 2026.
watch_out: The remove.bg website closes on 1 December 2026 and its background remover moves into Canva; subscriptions end then, and any unused pay-as-you-go credits expire.

name: Windsurf
good_for: An AI code editor that understands your whole project and can change many files at once, with you watching each step.
watch_out: The free plan only gives you a light quota for AI agents; the Pro plan costs $20 a month. Windsurf is now called Devin Desktop.

good_for: Create original songs in over 250 styles in seconds, even with no music training.
name: AIVA
watch_out: The free and Standard plans keep copyright with AIVA and limit commercial use; only the Pro plan transfers full ownership to you.

good_for: Build an AI chatbot or support agent for your website, WhatsApp, or Slack that answers questions and can do real tasks.
name: Botpress
watch_out: The $150/month price needs a yearly plan (monthly is $189). The Plus plan includes 250 conversations a month, and extra packs cost $65 per 100.

good_for: Drafting marketing content and pulling live web data inside one chat window.
name: ChatSonic
watch_out: It is built for marketing work rather than everyday chatting, and the $16/month price is billed annually.

good_for: Type a script and get a training-style video narrated by an AI avatar, with quizzes and course exports.
name: Colossyan
watch_out: The $59/month price needs a yearly plan, the free plan keeps a Colossyan watermark, and unused minutes do not roll over.

good_for: Ask a research question and get structured evidence tables pulled from over 138 million academic papers.
name: Elicit
price_from: $11/month (Academic Plus plan, billed annually; $49/month on the Pro plan for everyone else)
watch_out: The free plan has limited usage for the Research Agent and Research Reports, and the $11/month Academic Plus price is billed as $132 a year; the Pro plan for everyone else is $49 a month, billed as $588 a year.

good_for: Turn a text prompt into a finished video with stock footage and AI voiceover without editing anything yourself.
name: InVideo
price_from: $20/month (Starter list price, billed monthly; the page currently shows 50% off with yearly billing, $10 a month)
watch_out: Paid plans run on credits that do not roll over, and costs are hard to predict because every AI model burns credits at a different rate.

good_for: Edits videos in a web browser with AI tools for subtitles, voiceovers, resizing, and background removal.
name: Kapwing
watch_out: Free exports carry a Kapwing watermark and are limited to 4-minute 720p clips, and the free plan includes only 10 credits for the AI tools.

good_for: An AI teammate that handles your email, calendar, meetings, and routine office work when you tell it what to do.
name: Lindy
watch_out: The $50 of free credits lasts only 7 days, then paid use starts at $29.99 per user per month. Credits do not roll over, and bigger jobs use more of them.
